rationale: The Latin anchor *buccella* means "a small morsel/mouthful of bread," and *manducaverunt panem* confirms the context of eating bread; the attestations from John's Gospel (13:27,30) refer to the morsel/sop given at the Last Supper. Synset morsel.n.02 ("a small amount of solid food; a mouthful") matches this sense precisely, with the example "a bit of bread" being directly parallel.
